clips.send: A woman who drinks soy milk daily sends it to her partner before their next grocery run - the anxiety of a hormone swap nobody warned them about.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau doesn't touch soy, and won't put a client on it either.

His concern: soy can raise estrogen, and he lists what follows - water retention, higher blood pressure, lower testosterone, even brain fog. He says the industry would rather you not ask.

Soy hides in more than tofu: shakes, protein bars and meat substitutes all carry it under different names.

Next time you read a label, check for soy protein isolate or soy lecithin before it goes in the cart.
